project_type: TypeScript Node CLI plus static web site (web/index.html, app.js, copy.js, style.css), built by scripts/build-site.ts
test_framework: vitest + fast-check, tests/*.test.ts (site.test.ts, page-above-fold.test.ts, first-60-seconds.test.ts, devpost-docs.test.ts, static.test.ts)
build_command: npm run build:web && npm run build:site
verification_instructions: npm test; npm run test:visual (scripts/ci/visual-qa.mjs); take screenshots 1440x900 and 390x844 into docs/img/
snapshot_or_generated_files: Do not run kiro:stats --write or kiro:timeline (steering tech.md). tests/__snapshots__ exists; update only if needed with vitest -u.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET. Node 22. gh CLI not authenticated; use curl on api.github.com unauthenticated. Action logs need auth.
contribution_requirements: Steering in .kiro/steering: blameless (no person named near a failure; UI copy states actions, no prohibitions), failsafe, tech (record third-party in ATTRIBUTION.md), product (feature freeze Nov 27: copy/demo-path fixes OK). No em dashes. Do not touch docs/playtest/RESULTS.md. Do not run stats/timeline.
key_patterns: site.test.ts line ~250 forbids absolute http URLs in index.html/app.js/css/js except allowlist; allowlist has github.com/e-1305/ only for live modules
directory_structure: web/ site, docs/ markdown, tests/, scripts/, scripts/ci/visual-qa.mjs
